title: California Singer/Rapper John Givez Released New Single "SKRRT"
htmlContent:
John Givez, the rising R&B singer/rapper from Oceanside, California, has released his newest single, "SKRRT," showcasing his versatile talent and unique style. With his diverse background and experiences, Givez has created a new lane within the music and entertainment industries.

In "SKRRT," Givez's smooth vocals glide over a melodic beat as he delivers his signature introspective and truthful lyrics. The song explores the ups and downs of relationships as Givez reflects on the pain of heartbreak and the struggles of moving on.

Despite his young age, Givez's talent has earned him a loyal and prominent fan base thanks to his raw authenticity and poetic execution. With influences ranging from the early 90s and 00s R&B to iconic rappers like Tupac, OutKast, and DMX, Givez's music is a fusion of different genres that showcases his creativity and originality.

As Givez continues to grow and evolve as an artist, "SKRRT" reminds him of his unique talent and ability to captivate audiences with his powerful and honest music.
